title: Thankful Rest: Come to Bed With Me? 8 Hours of Rustling Fall Winds and Autumn Leaves for Sleep
description:
Come to bed with me? A thankful, slow autumn: red and gold leaves over the Niagara gorge, river paths, sumac and sycamores, and a misty gorge to finish, with a few leaves drifting down on the breeze. It all fades slowly to pure black by twenty minutes so nothing lights up your room. Then it's just you, Mateo and the fall wind for eight hours.

A soft breeze always moving, slow gusts that swell and let go, dry leaves rustling overhead with every gust, and now and then a few skittering across the ground. No birds, no music, no talking, nothing sudden. The wind never loops: every gust is generated fresh by Sandoval Studios. Photos by Matthew: the Niagara gorge and river trails closer to home.

REST. DIGEST. Happy Thanksgiving. Goodnight.
